Dashboard.desc: Intelligent monitoring and predictive modeling for maize crops.
Dashboard.card_cv_desc: Classify maize leaves by uploading photos to detect Rust, Blight, or Gray Spot using the consensus of 3 CNN models (MobileNet, ResNet, EfficientNet).
Dashboard.card_automl_desc: Upload field datasets and run automatic training for 5 models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, MLP, Stacking, and Voting) with statistical tests.

CV.upload_label: Drag or select a maize leaf photo
CV.result_title: Consensus Results of the CNN Consortium
CV.no_consensus_desc: The three models predicted different diseases. We suggest capturing another photo with better lighting conditions.
CV.c_export_desc: Download the quantized convolutional model as C/C++ source code, ready to compile and deploy on Arduino, ESP32, or other embedded microcontrollers.
